_comment: Advisories we accept for now. One entry per advisory id (any alias works); a reason and an expires date (YYYY-MM-DD) are required, and an entry stops working on its date so the decision is revisited. scripts/audit-dependencies.py reads this file.

ignore.reason: zip is used only by tauri-plugin-updater to unpack a Windows update archive, after the archive's minisign signature is verified, so exploiting it needs our signing key. The fix is tauri-plugin-updater 2.14 (zip 9), which needs tauri 2.12 (FU-120).
